name: ContentRatings
description: Adds content advisory descriptors (nudity, violence, language), MPA ratings, and budget/revenue stats to movies using Wikidata - no API keys required
overview: Content advisory (nudity/violence/language) and box office stats for movies, sourced from Wikidata

versions.changelog: Real content descriptors (nudity, violence, language, drug use) via Wikidata's MPA rating qualifiers. Fixed IMDb ID lookup, fixed a cache-path bug that crashed the API, loosened auth so regular users can see ratings, and wired the panel into the web client.
